CustomField.description: Default HubSpot association type id, used by every portal that has no per-portal override (Association_Type_Id_TriBU__c / _CARL__c / _Spain__c). Suitable on its own for HUBSPOT_DEFINED defaults, whose ids are stable across portals (e.g. Contact-to-Company 279, Contact-to-Deal 4). Custom-object and USER_DEFINED label ids are generated per portal - leave this blank and fill the per-portal fields instead. Confirm ids via GET /crm/v4/associations/{from}/{to}/labels in each portal.
CustomField.label: Association Type Id
